quotes.author: Tripadvisor
quotes.text: Went out yesterday with my sister, had another great time on this boat, been fishing it past couple of years and always have a blast with Captain Nick, Jeremy and Mark when he’s there, won the pool with trigger fish, had a nice cobia but just shy of a keeper.

quotes.author: Tripadvisor
quotes.text: The Captain took us to some good spots and moved around as the keeper fish became depleted. A lot of nice fish was caught and enjoyed my time not only winding them in but doing so with some good fishermen on a Wednesday. Professional service as well.

quotes.author: Tripadvisor
quotes.text: Great day out with Sea Spirit! Reed and Jeremy are amazing. So kind, helpful, and funny. We Went out with my 4 daughters and they helped them out so much and made some wonderful memories for them. Highly recommend this place.

quotes.author: Tripadvisor
quotes.text: The crew were great and the weather was even better. The Captain kept moving to different spots so everyone had a great day of fishing. I did win the pool which of course made my day even better.

quotes.author: Tripadvisor
quotes.text: Really good fishing! The crew was very helpful, especially Captain Nick. We will be returning again soon because of how great he was.

quotes.author: Tripadvisor
quotes.text: What an amazing morning. This is a great crew that hustles the entire time to keep you fishing. We will be repeat customers.
